Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?

Our two most popular everyday styles are roller blinds and Venetian blinds, so let me break them down:



Roller blinds - one smooth fabric panel that rolls up neatly. Simple to use, minimal upkeep, huge range of fabrics including blackout and moisture-resistant ones. Best if you want clean lines and low effort day to day.


Venetian blinds - horizontal slats (usually aluminium or wood-effect) you can tilt for precise light and privacy control. Best if you like adjusting light throughout the day without raising the blind fully.



For your priorities of everyday use and value, I'd lean toward roller blinds: fewer moving parts means less wear and maintenance over time, and they're typically the kinder option on the budget. If precise light angling matters more to you, Venetians win instead.
